description: Schema + security foundation: TOTP deps, shared audit-action catalogue + the one new permission key (admin.support.revoke) with a generalized catalogue-sync test, the new Prisma migration (audit_events + support_grants + User MFA fields + RLS + append-only trigger + GRANT refresh + permission seed) applied against live Supabase, and the breakGlassPrisma client + withSupportGrant helper in packages/db. This is the spine FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on; it must be applied first. Depends on nothing. Maps to impl-plan.md steps 1-4.
steps: Step 1: Add otplib and qrcode (+ @types/qrcode devDep) to apps/api/package.json at EXACT pinned versions (no ^) and install (updates root package-lock.json). qrcode is already present in node_modules; otplib is not. No runtime wiring yet.

Step 2: Create packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts exporting AuditActionDef, AUDIT_ACTIONS (exactly the keys in design 4.1: 14 campus_movement.*, 15 admin.*, 9 platform.*), AuditActionKey, AUDIT_ACTION_KEYS, AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET, and LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP: Record<AuditAction, AuditActionKey> with the full 28-value enum->key mapping from design 4.4 (note EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE -> campus_movement.pass.override; SHIFT_* -> campus_movement.shift.*). Export from packages/shared/src/index.ts.
Step 2b: Add admin.support.revoke to PERMISSIONS (module admin, description per design 3) in packages/shared/src/permissions.ts and to ROLE_PERMISSIONS.ADMIN.

Step 2c: Add apps/api/src/services/__tests__/audit-actions.test.ts: every key matches ^[a-z_]+(\.[a-z_]+)+$, no duplicates, AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET equals AUDIT_ACTION_KEYS; LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP has exactly 28 entries, one target each, every target in AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET.

Step 2d: Generalize apps/api/src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts: replace the single MIGRATION_DIR with a SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS array = [identity_rbac_b2, <the new superadmin_security dir>]; run extractPermissionKeys()/extractRolePermissionPairs() per file, UNION (de-duped, still asserting no intra-file duplicates), assert set-equality of the union against PERMISSION_KEYS / ROLE_PERMISSIONS; keep the injected-drift self-check. Do NOT edit the frozen identity_rbac_b2 SQL. Fill in the exact new dir name after Step 3.

Step 3: Edit packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma per design 2.1/2.2/2.3: add enums AuditResult (SUCCESS|DENIED|ERROR) and SupportGrantStatus (REQUESTED|ACTIVE|EXPIRED|REVOKED); models AuditEvent (@@map audit_events) and SupportGrant (@@map support_grants) with single-column FKs (AuditEvent.actorUserId plain FK via @relation("AuditEventActor"); institutionId nullable); add mfaRecoveryCodes Json? and mfaEnrolledAt DateTime? to User; add back-relations on Institution (auditEvents), User (auditEvents @relation("AuditEventActor"), supportGrantsGranted @relation("SupportGrantGrantee"), supportGrantsRevoked @relation("SupportGrantRevoker")), and SupportGrant (auditEvents).

Step 3b: Hand-author packages/db/prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_superadmin_security/migration.sql mirroring the two existing migrations' structure, ordered per design 2.6: (1) CREATE TYPE AuditResult, SupportGrantStatus; (2) CREATE TABLE support_grants + indexes + single-col FKs to institutions/users; (3) CREATE TABLE audit_events + indexes + single-col FKs (institutionId->institutions, actorUserId->users, supportGrantId->support_grants); (4) ALTER users ADD mfaRecoveryCodes, mfaEnrolledAt; (5) support_grants_purpose_nonempty CHECK (length(btrim(purpose))>0); (6) DO $$ ENABLE+FORCE RLS + EXACTLY these policies and NO TO postgres policies: support_grants_tenant_read (FOR SELECT USING institutionId = nullif(current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true), '')), tenant_isolation_select on audit_events (same nullif-guarded USING), audit_events_tenant_insert on audit_events (FOR INSERT WITH CHECK same nullif-guarded); (6a) CREATE FUNCTION audit_events_append_only() RAISE EXCEPTION + CREATE TRIGGER audit_events_no_update_delete BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON audit_events; seed admin.support.revoke into the permissions INSERT block and the ADMIN pair into the role_permissions INSERT block using the SAME markers the catalogue-sync test parses (INSERT INTO "permissions" ... ON CONFLICT; INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... AS m(); (7) guarded campass_app GRANT refresh: audit_events keep SELECT, INSERT + REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE FROM campass_app; support_grants keep SELECT + REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE FROM campass_app.

Step 3c: Apply + generate: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate dev --name superadmin_security then npx prisma generate. Record the generated migration dir name back into SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS in the catalogue-sync test.

Step 4: In packages/db/src/index.ts add per design 6.2: extend globalForPrisma type with breakGlassPrisma; create breakGlassPrisma from process.env.DATABASE_URL (campass_app, 6543); add cached assertBreakGlassRoleIsRlsSubject(tx) probe (SELECT rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user; throw if bypass or unknown); export withSupportGrant(institutionId, fn) whose tx runs, in order: SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY (FIRST), the probe, SELECT set_config('app.current_institution_id', $1, true), then fn(tx), with { maxWait: 15000, timeout: 30000 }.
acceptance_criteria: otplib resolves at runtime (node -e "require('otplib')") and both deps are pinned to exact versions in apps/api/package.json.
The new migration applies cleanly (`prisma migrate dev` succeeds; a re-run reports no pending migrations) and `prisma generate` produces auditEvent + supportGrant delegates and the AuditResult type.

`cd apps/api && npx vitest run src/services/__tests__/audit-actions.test.ts src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts` passes (catalogue-sync union matches @campusgate/shared with admin.support.revoke present).
The frozen identity_rbac_b2 and B-1 migration.sql files are byte-for-byte unchanged.
withSupportGrant and breakGlassPrisma are exported from @campusgate/db and root `npm run build` passes.
verification: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate dev --name superadmin_security && npx prisma generate
npm run build   (root Turborepo build passes)
cd apps/api && npx vitest run   (all baseline tests still green; new catalogue/audit-action tests pass)
findings:
GENERATED MIGRATION DIR: 20261019053533_superadmin_security (packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261019053533_superadmin_security/migration.sql). Applied to live Supabase and recorded as a finished row in _prisma_migrations. FEAT-002/003 must reference this exact dir name if they parse or extend the seed.

DEPS: pinned EXACT versions in apps/api/package.json — otplib 12.0.1 (v13 is a breaking rewrite; 12.x has the stable authenticator API and is the established Node TOTP choice), qrcode 1.5.4 (already in node_modules), @types/qrcode 1.5.5 (devDep). No runtime wiring yet; `node -e require('otplib')` resolves.

AUDIT-ACTION CATALOGUE (packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts, exported from shared index): 37 keys total = 14 campus_movement.* + 14 admin.* + 9 platform.*, matching design §4.1 EXACTLY. NOTE/DEVIATION: FEAT-001.json step 2 said '15 admin.*' but design §4.1 (source of truth) lists 14 admin keys — there is NO admin.support.revoked AUDIT action; the tenant revoke is audited as platform.support_grant.revoked (design §7.2). Implemented 14 admin keys to match the design and keep LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP (exactly 28 entries) targeting only the 14+14 campus_movement/admin keys. LegacyAuditAction is a local string-literal union (NOT a @prisma/client import) so @campusgate/shared stays free of a db dependency; the map is still exhaustively type-checked.

PERMISSION: added exactly one new key admin.support.revoke (module 'admin') to PERMISSIONS and to ROLE_PERMISSIONS.ADMIN in packages/shared/src/permissions.ts. Seeded in the new migration's permissions + role_permissions blocks (idempotent ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).

CATALOGUE-SYNC TEST: generalized to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS = ['20261018171747_identity_rbac_b2','20261019053533_superadmin_security']; unions per-file extractions (de-duped, still asserting no intra-file dups) and asserts set-equality of the union against PERMISSION_KEYS/ROLE_PERMISSIONS. PITFALL for future migrations: the extractor uses the literal markers INSERT INTO "permissions" ... ON CONFLICT and INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... AS m( — do NOT write those exact strings inside SQL comments or the slicer will match the comment first (this bit this feature; the seed-block comment was reworded to avoid the markers).

SCHEMA (packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma): added enums AuditResult(SUCCESS|DENIED|ERROR), SupportGrantStatus(REQUESTED|ACTIVE|EXPIRED|REVOKED); models AuditEvent(@@map audit_events) and SupportGrant(@@map support_grants) with single-column FKs; User.mfaRecoveryCodes Json? + User.mfaEnrolledAt DateTime?; back-relations on Institution (auditEvents, supportGrants — note supportGrants back-relation is REQUIRED by Prisma even though design §2.2 only named it on the SupportGrant side), User (auditEvents @relation("AuditEventActor"), supportGrantsGranted @relation("SupportGrantGrantee"), supportGrantsRevoked @relation("SupportGrantRevoker")), SupportGrant (auditEvents). prisma generate emits auditEvent + supportGrant delegates + AuditResult/SupportGrantStatus types.

MIGRATION APPLY PATH (Option C, per parent): the live _prisma_migrations ledger has PRE-EXISTING metadata-only drift (B-1 recorded checksum != committed file; a rolled-back duplicate identity_rbac_b2 row) that makes `prisma migrate dev` demand a data-wiping reset. DO NOT use migrate dev against the shared Supabase DB. This migration was applied with `npx prisma migrate deploy` (it applies only the pending migration and ignores historical checksum drift). GOING FORWARD FOR FEAT-002/003: author migrations with `prisma migrate dev --create-only` (or hand-author) locally, then `prisma migrate deploy` — never `migrate dev` against production. The ledger drift is deferred as separate housekeeping; the frozen B-1/identity_rbac_b2 SQL is byte-for-byte unchanged and no _prisma_migrations row was edited.

LIVE VERIFICATION (queried via DIRECT_URL): audit_events + support_grants both ENABLE+FORCE RLS; policies exactly support_grants_tenant_read(SELECT), audit_events.tenant_isolation_select(SELECT), audit_events.audit_events_tenant_insert(INSERT) — all nullif()-guarded, NO TO postgres policies; trigger audit_events_no_update_delete (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE) present; CHECK support_grants_purpose_nonempty present; campass_app grants = audit_events SELECT+INSERT (UPDATE/DELETE revoked), support_grants SELECT only (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE revoked); admin.support.revoke seeded + mapped to ADMIN.

DB HELPER (packages/db/src/index.ts): extended globalForPrisma with breakGlassPrisma; exported breakGlassPrisma (new PrismaClient from process.env.DATABASE_URL = campass_app 6543); cached assertBreakGlassRoleIsRlsSubject(tx) probe (SELECT rolbypassrls ... current_user; throws if bypass/unknown); exported withSupportGrant(institutionId, fn) whose tx runs SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY first, then the probe, then set_config('app.current_institution_id',$1,true), then fn(tx), with {maxWait:15000,timeout:30000}. withSupportGrant is NOT yet called by any route (FEAT-003 wires it). FEAT-002 audit writer should import recordAuditEvent pattern from design §4.3 (privilegedPrisma fallback; pass tx for tenant writes).

VERIFICATION RESULTS: root `npm run build` passes (all 3 packages); `cd apps/api && npx vitest run` = 148 passed / 18 files (includes new audit-actions.test.ts + generalized catalogue-sync.test.ts). One flaky fast-check property test (reliability-engine.property.test.ts) failed once on a random seed then passed on re-run — pre-existing, unrelated to FEAT-001.
